run_relicense_script: run the relicense script on a directory to replace LGPL3 headers with MPL2 headers
update_license_header: update a file's LGPL3 license header to MPL2 using the update function
review_update_function: review the update function that replaces LGPL3 headers with MPL2 headers in text
refactor_relicense_exclusions: refactor the relicense script to add more files to the exclusions set
summarize_relicense_script: summarize the relicense script that batch converts LGPL3 to MPL2 license headers
